heroLead: From Mendoza, Argentina, I develop web applications that combine thoughtful design with intuitive navigation. I also turn manual processes into tools that simplify everyday work.
aboutP1: I'm María José, though everyone calls me Majo. I'm studying Information Systems Engineering at UTN and working in software development, with an interest in building tools that solve practical problems.
aboutP2: I started out in frontend development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Today, I work across the stack, from the user interface to the database and deployment. I like understanding how people work and finding ways to make their tasks easier through software.
contactLead: Have an opportunity or a project in mind? Get in touch!
